description: This Java class implements a progress listener for file uploads using Apache Commons FileUpload, tracking upload progress such as bytes read, total content length, and number of items.

classes.name: FileUploadProgressListener
classes.description: A progress listener for tracking multipart file upload progress.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates progress metrics during file upload.

methods.name: getContentLength
methods.description: Returns the total size of the uploaded content.

methods.name: getBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes read so far.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the number of items processed.

methods.name: hasStarted
methods.description: Indicates whether the upload has started.
